newsitem.title: USA: Compost America makes Miami payment.
newsitem.headline: Compost America makes Miami payment.

text.p: Compost America Holding Co Inc said Monday it has issued a one-time host fee payment of $1 million to the City of Miami.
In so doing, the company said, it has taken an important step on its way to building a composting facility in Dade County, Fla.

The projected 350,000-square-foot facility, to be situated on 40 company-owned acres, will process 800 tons per day of municipal solid waste and biosolids. With construction to begin during 1997, the facility is scheduled to be up and running by late 1998, the company said.

In addition to the expected $371 million in revenues the 30-year put-or-pay City of Miami contract will generate by itself, other sources of revenue during the same period will increase total revenues to some $750 million, President Roger E. Tuttle said.
